text: Chapter 3. Insurance and Indemnification E. Commercial General Liability (CGL) Insurance 1. [3:290] Relevant CGL Policy Provisions: Standard form Commercial General Liability (CGL) policies contain various provisions relevant to employment-related claims: a. [3:291] Insuring clauses: CGL policies contain two separate insuring provisions under which coverage may be claimed: (1) [3:292] “Bodily injury liability” coverage: The first provision covers all sums which the insured shall become legally obligated to pay as damages “because of bodily injury … caused by an occurrence” during the policy period; and obligates the insurer to defend “any suit” seeking such damages.
